topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can’t quite find the words to express what I’m feeling as I stand here, staring at the ‘For Lease’ sign taped to the door of my favorite restaurant. The place where I used to meet friends, to celebrate, to decompress after a long week—it’s just... gone. I keep thinking about all the times I walked in, greeted by the familiar scent of fresh bread and the warm, inviting atmosphere. Now, everything seems so final. I guess I’ll have to find somewhere else to go, but it won’t be the same. Part of me hopes that wherever I end up, it can hold some of the memories this place did.
